### As God Is Our Witness
Author: Michelle S. Lazurek
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-couples-devotional/as-god-is-our-witness-crosswalk-couples-devotional-september.html
Passage: Malachi 2:14-16
Points:
- Marriage vows are made before God, who stands as an active witness to the covenant.
- The Lord sees every daily act of love and service, even when a spouse fails to notice or appreciate them.
- Unmet expectations of grand romantic gestures can blind spouses to the steady, everyday care taking place.
- Remembering that God witnesses all actions encourages partners to faithfully cherish one another in small, practical ways.

### Wife, Guard Your Spirit from Unfaithfulness
Author: Tanner Kay Swanson
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/wife-guard-your-spirit-from-unfaithfulness
Passage: Malachi 2:15
Points:
- Unfaithfulness begins internally within the thoughts, desires, and affections of the human spirit.
- Guarding the spirit requires vigilant self-examination concerning where one's inner attention and daydreams wander.
- Investing intentionally in the home nurtures marital contentment and curbs the urge to seek satisfaction elsewhere.
- Structuring time wisely keeps idleness from opening doors to emotional compromise.
- Moderating media habits protects the heart from envious comparisons with curated, unrealistic portrayals of life.
